title: Politically exposed person assessment and control
workflow: Identify applicable PEP and related-person policies per institution and product
Screen subject plus required connected parties using permitted sources
Review candidate role, relationship, jurisdiction and effective timeframe
Escalate uncertain matches for human disposition and reasoned evidence
Apply approved risk-appropriate diligence and monitoring controls
Set periodic/event-driven review with immutable version history
controls: Name similarity alone does not establish PEP status
PEP indication does not automatically establish criminality, sanctions or prohibition
Screening must distinguish current, former and related-person findings where policy requires
Do not hardcode a universal declassification period without applicable legal approval
Treat unavailable provider or disputed match as explicit pending case, not cleared
Protect restricted PEP investigation data and limit disclosures by role and purpose
planned_test_cases: False-positive match requires reviewed evidence and audit
Potential PEP with missing source cannot auto-clear
Former public-office record evaluated under effective-dated policy
Unauthorized staff cannot see restricted investigation notes
Source edition change triggers controlled reassessment
review_gate: Qualified AML interpretation, approved PEP sources and institution-specific screening and EDD policies.
